description: This file implements an HTTP server class with routing, WebSocket support, and file serving capabilities, including range requests handling.

classes.name: HttpServer
classes.description: A class that manages an HTTP server with routing, WebSocket, and file serving functionalities.

methods.name: server
methods.description: Returns the underlying HTTP server instance.

methods.name: routePrefix
methods.description: Adds a route with a prefix and handler.

methods.name: routePath
methods.description: Adds a route with an exact path and handler.

methods.name: port
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: createWebSocket
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket connection with the specified transport and optional GUID.

methods.name: wsGuid
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket GUID if set.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server with optional port, preferred port, and host.

methods.name: urlPrefix
methods.description: Returns the URL prefix based on the purpose ('human-readable' or 'precise').

methods.name: serveFile
methods.description: Serves a file over HTTP, handling range requests if specified.
